summary_md: **Apurv Sheldiya ([@Apurv35904761](https://x.com/Apurv35904761/status/2116722964859433125))** summarizes *ThinkJev* by Ding et al. ([arXiv 2610.37732](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37732)), which builds fast and slow systems from one hybrid-thinking model and only thinks when it helps typed decisions, reaching 81.6% accuracy with 72% of always-thinking tokens.

referenced_urls.title: ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions
